other_conditions: Applicant must be a member of the approved vocation/occupation groups.
Group must have a minimum of 25 members.
benefits_summary: Provides death cover up to ₹50,000 (₹20,000 for natural death, ₹50,000 for accidental death), disability benefits up to ₹50,000, and scholarships of ₹300 per quarter per child (maximum two children) for school‑going children.
documents_required: Original death certificate of the deceased person
